clauses.clause: **0 HP never breaks down:** speed 60 % ± 2 %, heavy smoke, still drivable.
clauses.note: Fresh pooled physical L9 low/high controls: ordinary default start, one disclosed production damage(maxHP) zero-HP setup, actual WASD thereafter. Plateau medians (samples within1% of observed peak): zero10.715887m/s versus intact17.742259low/17.741516high =60.3975%/60.4001%, within58–62%; plateau samples145zero and135/96intact, speed caps0.6/1. Both zero-HP drives remain controllable through the authored road and reach actual crash/crawl at tick9192, with no browser errors. Opened all4 original1280x720 smoke views after4wallseconds of physical W: both wide views have a thick continuous grey billowing plume trailing several vehicle lengths; close views show its base behind the APC. VFX explicitly enabled, production clock unpaused during emission. Repro: BROWSER_POOL_JOB_ID=rr-b node --import tsx/esm test-results/rr-b/speed-producer.mjs low speed; repeat high; smoke-producer.mjs low/high for the visual fixture.
